Indian Stock Market Plunges Amid Global Economic Uncertainty

The Indian stock market experienced a significant downturn on July 8, with the Sensex falling by 1,700 points and the Nifty closing below 23,900. The cause of this decline is attributed to global economic uncertainty, including rising interest rates in the US. Investors have suffered losses of over ₹8 lakh crore due to the market crash.
